Toriri's former employer,
Lapacoll-san, tried to flee at night
but was caught by the army, mo...

rows.label: tlk42400045_02_msg0002
rows.name:
I never dreamed such a dangerous
poison called Thanatitan was being
made, mo.

rows.label: tlk42400045_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I thought it was the new Pollen Orb
product Toriri came up with, the
Mushroomy Pollen Orb, mo...

rows.label: tlk42400045_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Anyway, my employer was caught and
now Toriri is unemployed, mo.

rows.label: tlk42400045_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Is there anyone looking
for a helper, mo?
